sampling-presets.author: FL Studio Plugin Deep Dives Research Team
sampling-presets.description: Collection of optimized DirectWave configurations for different sampling scenarios in hip-hop, rap, and R&B production

presets.name: Hip-Hop Standard Drum Kit
presets.description: Standard drum kit mapping optimized for hip-hop beat creation with classic key assignments
presets.use_case: General hip-hop beat creation with standard drum mapping
benefits: Standard GM mapping for pattern compatibility
Optimized for classic hip-hop drum sounds
Balanced levels across all kit pieces
Appropriate filtering for each drum type
presets.notes: Perfect for beginners learning hip-hop drum programming or for quick beat creation sessions.

presets.name: Trap 808 Multiplicity
presets.description: Multiple 808 samples mapped across a range for varied bass programming in trap music
presets.use_case: Trap music production with varied 808 sounds for melodic bass lines
presets.notes: Use for creating melodic 808 patterns common in trap music. The velocity layers provide expression for melodic bass lines.

presets.name: Rap Vocal Chop Arrangement
presets.description: Mapped vocal chops across the keyboard for rap hook and ad-lib arrangement
presets.use_case: Arranging vocal hooks and ad-libs in rap production
presets.notes: Perfect for arranging vocal hooks and ad-libs in rap tracks. Each sample has appropriate effects processing.

presets.name: R&B Smooth Piano
presets.description: Velocity-sensitive piano with smooth response for R&B chord progressions and melodies
presets.use_case: Playing smooth R&B piano chords and melodies with expression
benefits: Smooth envelope settings for R&B feel
presets.notes: Perfect for R&B piano parts that require dynamic expression and smooth transitions between soft and hard playing.

presets.name: Hip-Hop String Section
presets.description: String samples with round-robin for realistic orchestral sections in hip-hop productions
presets.use_case: Adding orchestral elements to hip-hop productions
presets.notes: Use for adding lush string sections to hip-hop tracks. The round-robin provides realistic ensemble feel.

presets.name: Hip-Hop Percussion Kit
presets.description: Extended percussion kit for adding rhythmic elements to hip-hop productions
presets.use_case: Adding rhythmic percussion elements to hip-hop beats
benefits: Standard key mapping for easy programming
presets.notes: Perfect for adding classic percussion elements to hip-hop productions. Each sound is appropriately processed for the mix.

presets.name: R&B Brass Section
presets.description: Brass samples with velocity layers for expressive R&B horn sections
presets.use_case: Creating expressive brass sections for R&B productions
presets.notes: Perfect for R&B brass sections that need dynamic expression. The velocity layers allow for realistic crescendos and diminuendos.

presets.name: Hip-Hop Atmospheric Textures
presets.description: Atmospheric textures and ambient sounds for hip-hop background elements
presets.use_case: Creating atmospheric backgrounds for hip-hop productions
benefits: Streaming to save memory on long samples
presets.notes: Use for creating atmospheric backgrounds in hip-hop tracks. The ping-pong looping creates evolving textures without obvious repeats.

presets.name: Rap Vocal Processing Chain
presets.description: Vocal samples with built-in processing for modern rap production styles
presets.use_case: Modern rap production with processed vocal elements
benefits: Different processing for different vocal roles
presets.notes: Perfect for modern rap production where vocals have built-in processing. Each vocal element has appropriate effects for its role.
